The approach

Less performance.
More usable skill.

An emergency is already stressful. Training should reduce confusion, not add to it. Swift CPR is being rebuilt around direct explanation, deliberate practice, and repeatable response steps.

  • Clear demonstrations before practice
  • Hands-on repetition with useful correction
  • Plain-language response priorities
  • Training logistics designed around the group
